svg.title: Amiit.AI: Platform Architecture
svg.desc: Browser and messaging requests reach Amiit through the gateway and channel adapters. Its agent loop draws on Agentic Memory for context and calls tools through zaMCP to access tasks, knowledge, files, and secure credentials.
